title: A Windows clone works end to end
goal: A Windows 11 clone with Git for Windows works end to end and CI proves it: revision reads survive long Windows paths, the raw-read hint fires under the PowerShell tool, the tests compile without warnings, a run of tests.py and stress_test.py on the Windows host by a Claude session is on record for each change to the tools, the session-end launcher is proven on Windows, and a clean host has gone from no Python to a passing /kb-setup on record.
notes: Setup from no Python (install-python.ps1, uv pin, PowerShell allow rules, the missing-interpreter notice) landed with sprint SP-fep4fpsx “Windows ready”; the suite's Windows failures with BG-ovulgaal. ST-vtlw7fsu “Prove the session-end launcher on Windows” stays in SP-z7a5c76b “Delivery proven”. Out of scope, host setup rather than repository changes: running kbgit.py install-hooks and kb_mcp.py --register-local in a clone (/kb-setup does), a remote layout, turning off the Store's App Execution Aliases, enabling LongPathsEnabled, running Claude Code unelevated.
